definition_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the deal DEFINITION as AFB defined it — computed ONLY by AFB, over an AFB-owned allowlist (see docs/PROTOCOL.md, 'definition_hash'). BF stores the received value verbatim and never recomputes it (BF enriches the deal body — broker_instrument, broker_sizing, binding — so a BF-side hash would differ without any lost message); it echoes it in session.resync_request so AFB can see 'same revision, different content'. Optional: an older AFB omits it.
